entry.title: CFTC Charges 11 Companies and Two Indiana Executives in $550 Million Fraud Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Charges 11 Companies and Two Indiana Executives in $550 Million Fraud Scheme CFTC · Nov 20, 2026 · EnforcementThe Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed a complaint in federal court in Indiana against two executives and 11 affiliated companies. It alleges they ran a Ponzi scheme that took more than $550 million from at least 2,100 participants, claiming the money would fund leveraged forex trading. The complaint says little to no trading occurred, with funds misappropriated or used to pay fake profits, and solicitations continued through October 2026. The court froze assets and appointed a temporary receiver, and the CFTC seeks restitution, penalties, and a permanent injunction.

entry.title: UK regulator launches public platform showing how firms use AI in financial services

entry.title: Helping more people break the cycle of persistent credit card debt

entry.summary: Man Behind GST Refund Fraud Exceeding $580,000 and Money Laundering Scheme Convicted IRAS · Nov 17, 2026 · EnforcementFollowing investigations by IRAS and CAD, Lim Chit Foo was convicted on 14 counts of helping nine companies fraudulently obtain GST refunds totalling $260,609. entry.title: Full view of UK share trading across venues
entry.summary: Getting the full picture of trading in UK shares FCA · Nov 17, 2026 · GuidanceThe FCA notes that UK share trading is now spread across more venues and execution methods, so data focused on traditional venues may understate total activity. It launched a market activity reporter that brings together trading data from across UK execution venues and methods. The service now also provides FTSE 100 and FTSE 250 level data.

entry.title: SFC bans Kim Chung Wan for life after misrepresenting academic qualifications
entry.summary: SFC bans Kim Chung Wan for life for serious misconduct SFC · Nov 17, 2026 · EnforcementThe Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has banned Kim Chung Wan from re-entering the industry for life. The SFC found he is not fit and proper to be a regulated person and breached section 383 of the SFO.

entry.title: SFC and FMSB sign agreement to deepen dialogue on global market standards

The two sides will also share information on fixed income and currency market trends. The agreement is non-binding, and SFC engagement does not imply endorsement of FMSB publications. entry.title: FSRA proposes further integration of virtual assets into its regulatory framework

entry.title: ADGM Warns of Unauthorised Use of Its Academy Name in Investment and Trading Schemes
entry.summary: ADGM Issues Alert Concerning Misuse of the ADGM Academy Name in Investment and Trading Activities 09 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 9, 2026 · GuidanceThe ADGM Registration Authority has issued an alert that third-party websites and individuals are using the ADGM Academy name, logo and branding without authorisation to offer investment opportunities and trading services. The ADGM Academy is not licensed to offer investment opportunities, provide trading services or collect funds from the public. The public is advised to independently verify any claimed association, especially where payments or personal or financial information are requested, and particularly where funds are sought to be transferred to bank accounts outside the UAE.

entry.title: FSA job opening: market and liquidity risk monitoring for deposit-taking institutions

entry.title: IRS reminder urging taxpayers to prepare now for easier 2027 tax filing
entry.summary: IRS reminder: Take steps now to make tax filing in 2027 easier IRS · Nov 16, 2026 · GuidanceThe IRS encourages taxpayers to start preparing now for the 2027 filing season, as the first in a series of "Get Ready" reminders. It recommends gathering tax records, using IRS Individual Online Accounts or the IRS app to access tax information, and having a bank account for direct deposit refunds. The notice also says information on new law provisions, such as deductions for tips and overtime, continues to be released.

entry.title: CSRC International Advisory Committee holds 23rd meeting in Shanghai on capital market development

They offered advice on expanding long-term funds, linking private funds with public markets, smarter supervision, and institutional opening-up.

entry.title: HKMA and Swift explore cross-border payment interoperability via Project Ensemble and Swift ledger
entry.summary: HKMA and Swift continue the collaboration to explore cross-border payment interoperability through Project Ensemble and Swift ledger HKMA · Nov 16, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「explore the use of tokenised deposits in enhancing the efficiency and end-to-end experience of cross-border transactions」 The HKMA is strengthening its collaboration with Swift to explore tokenised deposits for more efficient cross-border transactions. The work examines interoperability between the Swift ledger and the settlement layer of Project Ensemble, with participating banks. The aim is cross-border payment mechanisms using multi-currency tokenised deposits.

entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Speech at China International Finance Forum · Hong Kong Summit SFC · Nov 16, 2026 · SpeechDr Kelvin Wong, Chair of the Securities and Futures Commission, delivered this speech at the China International Finance Forum · Hong Kong Summit. entry.title: CFTC sues Louisiana over state court order shutting down CFTC-regulated exchanges
entry.summary: CFTC Sues Louisiana After State Court Blocks CFTC-Regulated Exchanges CFTC · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementThe Commodity Futures Trading Commission sued Louisiana to block the state from banning event contracts offered by CFTC-regulated exchanges, clearing organizations and futures commission merchants. A state court had ordered more than 30 companies in the state to stop operating without notice or a chance to be heard. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said event contracts have traded openly in Louisiana for years and that the suit seeks to preserve the status quo while federal courts decide the issue.

entry.title: IRS names 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee
entry.summary: IRS appoints 10 new members to Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee IRS · Nov 13, 2026 · PersonnelThe IRS announced the appointment of 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee (ETAAC). Established by statute in 1998, the committee is a public forum for discussing electronic tax administration issues. Its members include state tax officials, cybersecurity experts, tax professionals, software developers, and representatives from payroll, financial, and consumer groups.

entry.title: IRS fiscal 2026 results: record tax collections, faster refunds and expanded digital services
entry.summary: IRS achieved historic performance in 2026 for American taxpayers, efficiently delivering new tax benefits to working families IRS · Oct 29, 2026 · ReportThe IRS announced its fiscal year 2026 results, reporting record tax collections of $5.6 trillion, up nearly 5 percent from the previous year. Total refunds and average refunds both increased, with about 90 percent of electronic filers receiving refunds in less than 21 days. The release also covers growth in digital service use, about $38 billion in revenue protected from identity theft refund fraud, and progress on Trump Accounts for children. entry.title: CFTC sues Arkansas to defend federal jurisdiction over prediction markets
entry.summary: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets CFTC · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementOn November 13, 2026, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) announced a lawsuit against Arkansas to block the state's effort to halt event-contract trading and impose civil penalties on CFTC-registered exchanges. The CFTC says Arkansas's civil enforcement action against Kalshi in state court is preempted by federal law. Chairman Michael S. Selig said the agency will keep defending its sole jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. Arkansas is the 11th state the CFTC has sued.
